itens.trecho: An Absolute Trainwreck: One Piece (Live Action) Deserves to Sink to the Bottom of the Ocean I cannot express just how much of a colossal failure the live-action adaptation of "One Piece" is. It's as if the creators set out to destroy everything that made the original series a beloved masterpiece. First and foremost, the casting is abysmal.

s1: My love of one piece,and underwhelming/ rushed final arc and too many close shots that tries to hide environment as much as possible force me to not rate this anything above 7.5. This series felt like first professional dish by a new chef, being guided by of a demanding MasterChef.

As a complete anime novice, approaching "One Piece" (2023) was a leap of faith. I'm accustomed to live-action, grounded narratives, not cartoonish worlds with fantastical elements. But driven by a desire to explore the world of anime, I dove in headfirst, and to my surprise, was swept away by the captivating story and vibrant characters.
